purpose: New independent synthetic narrow #520 launch-context source-fix check, separate from #531 real-document 24 questions, release/CLI adoption and provider/model/final-answer E2E.
author: independent evaluator /root/engine07_realworld_independent

candidate.identity: Immutable source SHA identifies candidate; package metadata remains pre-release.

prior_exposure.known: V2/v3/v4 were authored and observed by this evaluator; they are seen development controls. V1 failed operationally before semantic observation. All prior first results/files remain unchanged.
prior_exposure.parent_reported_development: Parent reports historical/full/development and seen-v2/v3/v4 replay PASS; evaluator has not read those root implementation/tests/corpora or independently rerun them.
prior_exposure.unread: Production Engine implementation, parent/root tests, historical/other corpora and fixtures.
prior_exposure.new_authoring: New complete interview/reply/quote/relative-clause/possessive/artifact/correspondence-reference controls after candidate freeze; no prior case text was copied and renamed.

design.positive: Retain v17 requested_relation and v30 Relevant for factual launch with neutral context or explicit other-product/non-launch-property/activity denial/retraction/withdrawal. This does not approve the truth of the other property.
design.negative: Do not permit requested_relation or Relevant where current/present/first-person launch denial/retraction/withdrawal/non-event concerns the same target/claim, or the launch correction owner/referent is unresolved.
design.affirmative: Separate canonical target as direct subject: TARGET was launched. No novel affirmative predicate, arbitrary number/AST, aliases or preparation feature.
design.ambiguity: Eight explicitly unresolved launch-correction cases li5-044,li5-048,li5-050,li5-052,li5-054,li5-056,li5-058,li5-060 are negative before observations. No forced ambiguous positive. pre-freeze-scope-review.json records the rationale.
design.raw_prebinding: Optimistic exact/exact proposal and exact_target/requested_relation/none raw in every case; tests correction of unsafe prebinding, not model extraction.
design.labels: Offline evaluator-controlled expectations excluded from Engine inputs, not externally human-approved/universal truth.

scoring.code: Byte-identical inherited score.py SHA256 9a9941bf7ab3ea8ac22e1c851940197fdf3ef65ffb975c1b6fc2ddaa0130f4e3; no lowered/permissive rules.
scoring.PASS: 60/60 outcomes; zero negative requested_relation/Relevant; zero withheld positive; no incomplete/duplicate/foreign/malformed/unexpected rows; exit0 and empty stderr.
scoring.v17_v30_distinction: Negative v30 Ambiguous with v17 requested_relation still violates the unchanged negative joint gate; do not conflate that with v30 false-Relevant.
scoring.failure: Operational errors are not safety successes. Retain first raw/FAIL without retries, rescoring, label edits or output overwrite.

stages.static: Count/required-fields/positive budget/label exclusion/direct supported target-subject signal/inherited code syntax/unchanged prior hashes; no Engine/semantic observation.
stages.freeze: Complete labels/inputs/protocol/scoring/probe/recorder and candidate/source/core/serde/executable hashes before first semantic Engine invocation.
stages.semantic: One deterministic public v17/v29/v30 probe process for the 60 cases; no semantic sentinel, model or provider.
stages.score: One application of inherited fixed scorer on preserved first raw.
stages.receipt: Verify prior/frozen files unchanged and record all-version final artifact manifest.

execution.identity_check: Immediately before invocation verify actual HEAD/source hash (bytes only), actual linked core rlib/serde/probe and complete frozen files.
execution.build_limit: Parent supplied completed core build for fixed source. Evaluator independently hash-checks/links with rustc; no independent rebuild or production source inspection.

limits: Synthetic controlled bounded English launch-context API source-fix check only; #531 primary-source acquisition/final answer/provider acceptance and release/CLI adoption remain unperformed here.
Candidate only, no baseline delta; prior-set percentages are not comparable improvement measurements.
60 scenarios are 30 matched pairs, not independent documents or exhaustive grammar/reference coverage.
Does not assess other property truth, aliases, arbitrary reference AST, new affirmative predicates, temporal reasoning or preparation/future-release behavior.
Serialized model_relevant/model_ambiguous reasons do not imply actual model calls.
V5 becomes consumed after first semantic observation and subsequent use is regression/development only.
